description: This file contains a SwiftUI extension for `ChannelsSettings` that defines the user interface for a channels configuration panel, including sidebars, detail views, and related UI components.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main view layout for the ChannelsSettings extension, including sidebar and detail views with lifecycle event handlers.

methods.name: sidebar
methods.description: Builds the sidebar section displaying enabled and available channels.

methods.name: detail
methods.description: Builds the detail view for the selected channel or a placeholder when none is selected.

methods.name: emptyDetail
methods.description: Provides a placeholder view prompting the user to select a channel.

methods.name: channelDetail
methods.description: Displays detailed information and controls for a specific channel.

methods.name: sidebarRow
methods.description: Constructs a single row in the sidebar representing a channel, with selection highlighting.

methods.name: sidebarSectionHeader
methods.description: Creates a header for sections within the sidebar, such as 'Configured' and 'Available'.

methods.name: detailHeader
methods.description: Builds the header section for the channel detail view, including status, last check, and error indication.

methods.name: statusBadge
methods.description: Creates a badge displaying the status text with appropriate color styling.
